name: Typing & Keyboard
when_to_use: A prompt being typed into ChatGPT / Claude, search-bar typing, code on screen, text type-on animations, texting on a phone mockup, slash commands typing themselves. Ali Abdaal's guide: typing or text sounds whenever text comes on screen.

sounds.name: Micro Static Tick 01
sounds.desc: A 20 ms grainy static tick; layer it letter by letter for digital type-on text.

sounds.name: Micro Static Tick 02
sounds.desc: A soft, noisy 20 ms static tick; good for type-on captions or code text appearing character by character.

sounds.name: Micro Static Tick 03
sounds.desc: A very bright, airy 20 ms static tick; use for fast type-on letters or terminal text.

sounds.name: Micro Static Tick 04
sounds.desc: A quiet 20 ms noisy tick; use under type-on text where the typing should barely be heard.

sounds.name: Micro Static Tick 05
sounds.desc: A 20 ms static tick with a touch of low thump; good for type-on letters and terminal output.

sounds.name: Micro Static Tick 06
sounds.desc: A bright, hissy 20 ms tick; suits digital type-on and code-scrolling accents.

sounds.name: Micro Static Tick 07
sounds.desc: A sharp, bright 20 ms static tick; layer it for fast digital type-on text.

sounds.name: Micro Static Tick 08
sounds.desc: A 20 ms grainy mid-bright tick; use for letter-by-letter text reveals.

sounds.name: Micro Static Tick 09
sounds.desc: A 20 ms static tick that swells slightly at the end; use for type-on letters or soft hover feedback.
